structure.opening_style: context-setting via industry trends or specific customer pain points
structure.section_organization: logical progression: Context -> Problem -> Solution (Feature) -> Technical Implementation -> Business Value
structure.code_integration: illustrative and functional, often introduced with 'Simply write...' or 'The syntax is simple...'
structure.conclusion_style: summary of benefits with direct links to documentation or 'getting started' guides

phrases_to_avoid: Data silo (unless describing a problem to solve)

communication.value_proposition: combining technical superiority (speed, scale) with business outcomes (ROI, TCO reduction, governance)
credibility_markers: Customer quotes (e.g., 'Chris Nishnick, Director of AI at Lippert')
Specific metrics (e.g., '50% improvement in prediction error rate')
communication.technical_depth: deep but accessible; bridges high-level strategy with low-level implementation details
